response.rationale: The sweatshirt is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), which satisfies RET-020 (priority 90). This defective-item rule outranks the standard out-of-window rule RET-008 (priority 10), which would otherwise deny the return at 41 days. No final-sale (RET-012) or fraud-hold (RET-051) conditions apply. Therefore the return is eligible for a refund or replacement.
